node.title: DSP8 unit-trace elliptic-curve router
node.statement: The unit-product trace fiber is the plane cubic X^2Y+XY^2-sigma XYZ+Z^3=0. In characteristic different from 2,3 it is a smooth geometrically irreducible genus-one curve when sigma^3!=27 and a one-node genus-zero curve when sigma^3=27. Raw ordered point-pair records have exact multiplicity G_25^c=4K_25^c=J_25^c, so DSP8 is a quotient-weighted subgroup point-pair estimate on this mostly elliptic family. The upstream same-(e1,e2) rational-conic chart does not parameterize this same-(e1,e3) residue.
